title: The Broken Content Programmer Art Fix
description: Updates TBC textures to look like pre texture update programmer art, meant to be used with PACP continuation project.
body:
Changes the textures of TBC to fit with how the programmer art textures looked, even the ones with BARELY visible changes. 
Intended to be used with PACP continuation project (https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pacp)
for the best experience, should still fit with most programmer art packs as long as they arent TOO ancient.
